validity.recommendation: No change to existence/classification/duplicate status. P7600 is a real, actively-being-built connector pipeline (“Газопровод подключения Тас-Юряхского и Верхневилючанского месторождений к МГ «Сила Сибири»”) that ties two Gazprom-licensed Sakha Republic oil-gas-condensate fields into the Power of Siberia trunk. It is explicitly named as item 9 of 13 in Russian government decree No. 3302-r (16 Nov 2024, legalacts.ru full text), which itself amends the earlier decree No. 2288-r (23 Aug 2024, reported by neftegaz.ru 852391) that first approved connecting these fields to the trunk. Classification (Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission/магистральный газопровод) is directly stated by the decree text itself (item 9 literally reads “Магистральный газопровод ‘Газопровод подключения...’”). Active construction is independently corroborated by (a) Interfax.ru 1065145 (25 Dec 2025, Gazprom Chairman Alexey Miller quoted directly on both fields, with Glavgosexpertiza's 10-Dec-2025 positive design-review conclusion reported in the same article), (b) Gazstroyprom's own procurement-tender PDF (gsprom.ru/tenders_2026-02.pdf) listing multiple live 2025-2026 work orders naming this exact object (trenchless Nyuya river crossing, pipe-laying, parallel power line, instrument calibration, logistics), and (c) neftegazpro.ru construction-progress reporting. No duplicate risk found: no other row in this 32-PID Far-East roster, nor any source found in this research pass, describes a separate/different pipeline at this location — all sources converge on one continuous connector project with two design stages (“Этапы 1, 2” per Interfax). CAVEAT: the two neftegazpro.ru articles used as secondary corroboration for Status/Operator contain an internal inconsistency with each other (18-Aug piece: designer = Gazprom Proektirovanie St.Petersburg branch, future operator = Gazprom Dobycha Noyabrsk, customer = “Gazprom Invest Noyabrsk”; 16-Jul piece: designer = Gazprom Proektirovanie Saratov branch, customer = generic “Gazprom Invest”, no operator statement) — this downgrades neftegazpro.ru's subsidiary-level specificity claims to low/medium confidence; core facts (existence, active construction, Gazstroyprom as general contractor) remain independently corroborated by the higher-tier government-decree and Gazstroyprom-tender sources and are unaffected.
